## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (e.g. `feat(editor): …`).
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm run format:check` pass.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes.
- [ ] Unit tests were added or updated and `npm run test:coverage` passes (coverage ≥ 95 % lines and branches).
- [ ] UI changes are covered by Playwright E2E tests and `npm run test:e2e` passes.
- [ ] Build, test and runtime output contain no new warnings or errors.
- [ ] Documentation (`README.md`, `docs/`, in-app help) is updated and matches the change.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under **Unreleased** (for user-visible changes).
- [ ] No new dependencies, or each new dependency is justified in the description.
- [ ] Security rules from [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md#security-rules) are respected (sandbox, CSP, IPC validation, no raw HTML).
